a.name: Heavy cloak swish
a.desc: A thick cloak whips past as the hero twists aside.
a.note: Main: kit cloth swish fs-14175 take 1 from 33 ms (skips its quiet lead-in so the flick lands by 47 ms). Under it a low air swosh (fs-60022) for body weight. Dark, fabric-first.

b.name: Fast air whoosh
b.desc: A clean, quick rush of air, like ducking a swing.
b.note: Main: kit whoosh fs-449988 (med-high whoosh), cut from 82 ms so its swell peaks at 51 ms (raw rise 133 ms). A quiet bright swoosh (fs-475132) adds sheen. No cloth, pure air.

c.name: Gravel step and flick
c.desc: A boot crunches on gravel as a cloak flicks past.
c.note: Main: Freesound Nox_Sound 'Mountain Boots Gravel' (one gritty boot scuff, rise 21 ms); on top the kit bright cloth flick fs-14193. Ground material instead of air, like jump C.

a.name: Soft cloth landing
a.desc: A light body thud in cloth, like a hop and soft landing.
a.note: Main: kit cloth thump fs-389999 (rise 9 ms, a dense 20 ms padded thud). A quiet low body-to-ground thump (fs-435504) adds weight and Kenney rpg cloth1 the clothes moving. Dark and soft, same cloth family as dodge A.

b.name: Boot push-off
b.desc: A boot kicks off hard ground with a quick lift of air.
b.note: Main: Freesound 'Jump to concrete' (0.13 s, rise 4 ms) for the boot leaving the ground; a quiet short bright swish (kit fs-393811) after it gives the upward lift. Brighter and airy, like dodge B.

c.name: Gritty rock hop
c.desc: Mountain boots crunch on rock and gravel as the hero leaps.
c.note: Main: Freesound Nox_Sound 'Boots Rock Jump Sequence' (rise 2 ms, gritty scrapes), a second rock boot scuff (Nox_Sound rock sequence) 30 ms later, and a quiet gritty ground layer (kit fs-395331) for body. All high-passed at 120 Hz to keep peaks down. Ground material, like dodge C; fits Ashen Ruins stone.

a.name: Slow sword miss
a.desc: A heavy sword swings through empty air, a bit deflated.
a.note: Main: kit fast sword swing fs-60004 from 15 ms, pitched down 3 semitones (slower, lower = sadder), with a quiet pitched-down blade movement (fs-395266) for edge.

b.name: Thin blade swipe
b.desc: A light, thin blade flicks past and hits nothing.
b.note: Main: kit sword movement single 3 (fs-395264, rise 18 ms, bright 2.4 kHz), pitched down 2 for a little droop. Short and clean.

c.name: Clumsy double swing
c.desc: Two wobbly swishes, like flailing at air and missing.
c.note: Main: kit double swish fs-388003 from 20 ms, pitched down 4 semitones and low-passed at 7 kHz so the two passes sag and slow. A flail rather than one clean miss.

a.name: Dead iron latch
a.desc: A tiny muffled iron latch that will not open.
a.note: Main: Freesound 'Metal Latch Sound Effect 2' (dark 400 Hz), cut from 7 ms to skip a pre-click, 65 ms long, low-passed at 2.5 kHz so it reads as a stuck latch, not a ring.

b.name: Muffled cloth tap
b.desc: A tiny dull tap, like knocking through thick cloth.

c.name: Stuck old key
c.desc: An old mechanical key pressed but jammed, a soft dull clack.
c.note: Main: kit vintage typewriter key fs-194795 take 1 from 5 ms (skips a pre-tap), pitched down 3 and low-passed at 2.5 kHz: a dull, stuck clack.

a.name: Dead wooden clunk
a.desc: A dull thunk on a thick dead log, a flat 'no'.
a.note: Main: kit tree-trunk wood impact fs-550918 take 3, first hit only (rise 11 ms, 360 Hz, dead and woody); a dull hammer thump (fs-264879 take 1) under it adds weight. Fits Rotten Hollow's rotting wood.

b.name: Dead padded thud
b.desc: A flat, dead thump, like hitting a sandbag.

c.name: Double door knock
c.desc: Two quick, dull knocks on a wooden door.
c.note: Main: kit door knock fs-268500 take 3 (first knock only, rise 4 ms) with a low-passed thud (fs-405535) 2 ms behind it for weight (offset avoids phase cancelling); then take 2's first knock pitched down 2 and 5 dB quieter at 85 ms, so the pair falls like a spoken 'uh-uh'.
